product_title: VFENG Premium 6-in-1 3M Skin Decals Screen Protector for 2016+ MacBook Pro 15 inch with Touch Bar(Model: A1707/A1990)-Gray
review_text:
I almost never write reviews on Amazon, yet this product truly did exceed my expectations given other similar sellers on Amazon. The only reason I'm not awarding it 5 stars is the interior and exterior decals differ slightly in color. Note this review was not sponsored or endorsed by the manufacturer.

As you can see from the pictures, the fit of this decal is almost EXACT, unlike other manufacturers where the Apple logo isn't cut correctly or the decal doesn't extend to the actual edges of the computer. The color matching on the exterior decals is also perfect, you cannot tell they have been applied.

The only issue I have with the product is the shade of gray for the interior decals is darker than the exterior, so there is a much more clear contrast (still minor). It would have been great if the interior decals were the same color as the exterior ones. I also found the alignment VERY slightly off beneath the mouse and on 2 of the scroll holes on the rear decal (again very slight, 1mm or so as you can see in the pictures).

Do not rush the installation process. It took me about 30 minutes to apply the 2 exterior decals and the palm rest decal. My advice is to keep the backing on half decal while you align the other half. This will prevent it from prematurely sticking to your computer and requiring you to peel and reapply (potentially stretching the decal in the process). When applying the top decal, I also recommend you start by aligning the Apple logo cutout, and work your way outwards towards the edges to minimize the chances of wrinkles or air bubbles.

The product is well packaged, in a sturdy letter-type package, and includes 2 microfiber cloths, some screen cleansing wipes and the decals / screen protectors. The manufacturer was also kind enough to supply application instructions via email prior to delivery. Overall I'm extremely satisfied with the product, I'd just wish all decals were the same shade of gray.

Time will tell how well the adhesion performs. This is using 3M ControlTak adhesive, true to the product's description, so I expect it will hold up well and will not leave residue when removed. As of now, I highly recommend this product.

UPDATE:
Over 7 months later and the decals look just as good as they did on day 1. They have not peeled in the slightest, and maintain a uniform shade of gray. Highly recommend.

product_title: SV3C Pan Tilt IP Camera Outdoor with Floodlight & Tracking, 1080P WiFi Rotate Dome Security Camera Support Max 128G SD Card Record, Color Night Vision, 2-Way Audio, Motion Detection, RTSP Browser View
review_text:
I have probably 5 different security camera brands around my house and yard now, and I've never been thrilled with any of them, which is why I keep trying new brands. The weak point is often the software. THIS camera is the best combination of hardware and software I own. First, the hardware is great. It's all metal and feels really well made. You can used wired Ethernet or WiFi. The picture quality is excellent. The motion control is really cool. The only complaint I have on the hardware is the microSD card slot is a pain because it's secured with tiny Allen head machine screws. It's not something you want to do on a ladder. But you only need to do it once, so I'm not subtracting stars.

The software is feature rich and very usable. The best thing about it is they aren't trying to upsell you on a cloud service. Just pop in a microSD card and you are good to go, even when you're away from home. You can stream your recorded videos from anywhere. The playback interface is simple and effective. You will want to go through all the settings options to get the motion detection working the way you want it though. There are a few confusing options (possibly due to translation issues), but once you figure it out, all the functionality is there. For instance, they have separate options to both "capture" and "record" alarm events to the SD card. They just mean you can capture a still image (1-3 pics) and you can also record a video. There is a learning curve, but this software actually works far better than the other brands I have used. Be warned though that like most smart devices (switches, cams, lightbulbs, etc.), it can be finicky to initially connect it to your phone app. I had to get it into pairing mode and then connect to it's wifi access point. I got it working on the second try, which seems to be par for the course for smart devices, so I'm not mad at this camera in particular. I will say someone not tech savvy may be frustrated with it. For me, this is the best overall experience I've had, so it gets 5 stars. I'm really happy with it.
claim: The picture quality is excellent. The motion control is really cool.
notes: The playback interface is simple and effective.

product_title: Bluedio HT Turbine Wireless Bluetooth 4.1 Stereo Headphones, White
review_text:
These headphones work well and are very convenient. I have not had any problems with the headphones themselves in the 7 months I have owned them. The connection is always solid, the sound quality is great, the range is impressive, and the battery is long-lasting.

Connecting the headphones is fairly simple. Put the headphones on and hold the power button down until it says, "Ready to connect." Then, open the Bluetooth settings on the device you want to connect the headphones to, and select "Bluedio." The headphones will confirm when the connection is established.

The headphones have great sound quality, and the volume can be very loud. Be careful when listening to high volumes, or you will run the risk of damaging your hearing. Occasionally, you may experience a lag between between the visual and audio of a video or computer application. You will hear everything slightly after you should be hearing it, as if in a video, a person's voice is not synchronized with his mouth. If this happens, make sure you are not too far away from the device the headphones is connected to. You may need to hold down the power button until you hear a "beep." If that does not work, power the headphones off, then turn them on again. Closing the application that was transmitting the audio can help as well. I suspect this is not a problem inherit with the headphones.

Be careful when adjusting the headphones to fit your head. It seems the inside plastic can break somewhat easily. It has not broken for me, but I can tell that it will snap if a certain amount of pressure is imposed upon it. The headphones are not brittle or weak, but they are also not made from the strongest materials. Care must be taken when handling and storing them, or there will be a risk of damage.

Overall, I would recommend these headphones to anyone who is looking for a wireless pair of headphones with good quality.
claim: The headphones have great sound quality, and the volume can be very loud.
notes: It is wireless pair of headphones with good quality.

review_text: My biggest complaint with the Sony ZV-1 is battery life. I wish they had used the same battery as the Alpha a6000 series cameras. I love its portability, it can even fit in my pocket without the tripod/grip attached, let me say that again 4K video recording that fits in your pocket. The fact that Sony was able to build eye-tracking into such a small package is astounding and you still get the same amazing Sony picture quality, no wonder everyone uses Sony sensors. The portability and flip around screen make this camera perfect for vloggers, allowing you to easily see what the camera sees, whether shooting solo or with help. The microphone and windscreen do an adequate job of keeping wind noise down when you’re moving, but I wouldn’t trust it in very windy conditions. The product showcase setting is perfect for smaller e-commerce setups, making this an ideal unboxing or review camera when space is a concern. I haven’t tried the Bokeh setting, but there is a bokeh setting meaning you don’t need to spend a lot on an expensive lens to achieve similar results for the platforms that interest you unless of course, you want to. The ZV-1 like other Sony cameras can also be used as a webcam, and because of its size it is very well suited for this purpose, just download the software, plug in the USB change a couple of settings and you’re good to go. The bundled shooting grip pairs easily and provides an easy to control the camera when you’re creating content solo. All in all, this is content creators' dream camera, easy portability, outstanding picture quality, 4K shooting, webcam functionality, and the Sony ecosystem of camera tech. I’m definitely sold. I was able to purchase this camera at a discount in exchange for my honest review.

review_text:
I was excited to have received the ZV-1 Sony Vlog Camera. I saved the first use for the day I went hiking on a trail. This is my experience: Setup was extremely easy after charging the camera up! Battery and sd card goes in the same access port. Wind screen and the bluetooth remote tripod can easily attach to camera.

The bluetooth remote tripod accessory is worth praising in itself. Easy to maneuver, you can swivel it a full 360° and tilt it forward and backwards to a max 90° which is more than enough. Using the tripod, you can zoom in/out, record and take a photo. Conveniently enough, it has a provided lock function to prevent accidental touch. When attached to the ZV-1, with a grip weight of 7.6 oz., you don't feel the stress on your hand and arms even after carrying it for 2 hours during my hike.

There are some great functions to the ZV-1 that one looks for in their vlogging experience. You have the LCD screen which allows you to see what you are recording which I can tell you is necessary. Another feature I find necessary is the soft screen effect. Especially since you're filming in 4K mode, you have to look good for the camera. My skin isn't perfect and this feature helps me not shy away from placing the camera too close to my face. Oh; and speaking of "close", we need to talk about the "Product Showcase" aspect of the ZV-1. This means the ability to focus on what the camera owner is trying to show its viewers. It is superb in this camera as it quickly focuses on the item I place closest to the lens in front of me. I tested this in the outdoors where there are many distractions in the background and it performed really well. This function will work great in product reviews. There are a lot of other functions, modes and setting one can adjust for their preference but as someone who has been mostly using a phone, it can be a bit complicated to understand. Luckily, it has an auto-intelligence mode that will adjust the picture/recording settings for you so you don't have to fret. I will learn to understand the technicalities as I go on.

Another note to takeaway from my experience is about the battery life. After a full charge and being periodically used for picture taking and recording during my 2-3 hours I spent outdoors, the battery was already drained. I recommend having backup batteries for that matter. While my phone can do many things the ZV-1 can, there's also things only the ZV-1 can do. I'll be switching to the ZV-1 for my vlogging needs!
claim: There are some great functions to the ZV-1 that one looks for in their vlogging experience.Another feature I find necessary is the soft screen effect. Especially since you're filming in 4K mode, you have to look good for the camera.

review_text:
I have updated my review.

12/2020 UPDATE: new version of XOSS app allows easy download of files from bike computer via smartphone

This is a pretty excellent piece of hardware especially after a $20 off coupon code. It uses a standard Garmin mount, it syncs with my existing ant+ sensors and it did so very easily. It has a GPS, auto backlight, good battery life you can sort of configure it with an iPhone app via bluetooth.

You can't rearrange the screens on the device the way you want to. there are 3 pre-configured setups. If you want to see time of day along side heart rate, speed and cadence, you can't. You have to go with what they decided you want to see.

I had issues with strava upload and lack of ability to transfer fit or GPX files but that has been fixed. If the XOSS app ever disappears or doesn’t get updated then this computer will be a lot less useful, but for now it’s a great value and has lots of features.

Battery life is good and accuracy seems fine for my use.
